ref.title: Reference genome
ref.description: Reference genome build. The selected build must match the FASTA, dictionary, indexes, annotation VCFs, and BAM alignment build.

ref_fasta.title: Reference FASTA
ref_fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA used by MuTect1.

ref_fai.title: Reference FASTA index
ref_fai.description: FAI index corresponding to the reference FASTA.

ref_dict.title: Reference sequence dictionary
ref_dict.description: Sequence dictionary corresponding to the reference FASTA.

scatter_count.title: Scatter count
scatter_count.description: Number of parallel MuTect1 shards. Higher values may reduce wall-clock time but increase scheduling and compute overhead.

target_list.title: Target intervals
target_list.description: Optional BED or interval file restricting MuTect1 calling. Leave blank for genome-wide calling.

contest_target_intervals.title: ContEst target intervals
contest_target_intervals.description: Optional target interval file used by ContEst. ContEst runs only when this, SNP6 BED, and HapMap VCF are all supplied.

snp6_bed.title: SNP6 BED
snp6_bed.description: Optional SNP6 loci BED used by ContEst.

hapmap_vcf.title: HapMap VCF
hapmap_vcf.description: Optional HapMap VCF used by ContEst.

fracContam.title: Fallback contamination fraction
fracContam.description: Contamination fraction passed to MuTect1 when the full ContEst input set is not supplied.

dbsnp.title: dbSNP VCF
dbsnp.description: Optional dbSNP VCF for MuTect1 annotation.

dbsnp_idx.title: dbSNP index
dbsnp_idx.description: Index corresponding to the dbSNP VCF.

cosmic.title: COSMIC VCF
cosmic.description: Optional COSMIC VCF for MuTect1 annotation.

cosmic_idx.title: COSMIC index
cosmic_idx.description: Index corresponding to the COSMIC VCF.

read_group_blacklist.title: Read-group blacklist
read_group_blacklist.description: Optional file listing read groups that MuTect1 should ignore.

downsample.title: Downsample coverage
downsample.description: Maximum coverage used by MuTect1 downsampling.

max_mismatch_baseq_sum.title: Maximum mismatch base-quality sum
max_mismatch_baseq_sum.description: MuTect1 maximum mismatch base-quality sum threshold.

force_calling.title: Enable force calling
force_calling.description: Enable MuTect1 force-calling behavior configured by the pipeline.

exclude_chimeric.title: Exclude chimeric reads
exclude_chimeric.description: Exclude chimeric read pairs during MuTect1 calling.
